tweets.text:
🚀 OpenAI Launches o3 and o4-mini: A Leap Forward in AI Reasoning

OpenAI unveiled its latest AI models—o3 and o4-mini—marking a significant advancement in artificial intelligence capabilities.

The o3 model stands out as OpenAI’s most sophisticated reasoning AI to date, featuring enhanced abilities in web browsing, image generation, and visual comprehension. Meanwhile, the o4-mini offers high performance with greater speed and efficiency, particularly excelling in tasks like mathematics, coding, and visual analysis.  

A notable feature of these models is their ability to “think” with images, integrating visual inputs—such as sketches or whiteboards—into their reasoning processes.

In one standout example, a user asked:
“Make a movie involving an otter and an airplane. Figure it out with the tools you have.”
Despite lacking direct video generation tools, o3 generated each frame, then stitched them into a GIF—on the first attempt.

video credit: @emollick on x

In the world of Artificial intelligence, more data doesn’t always translate to better AI. What truly matters is the quality and specialization of the data being used.

Specialized data is curated and tailored for a specific task, providing clear focused information designed to solve a problem effectively, not random or cluttered content.

Think about it like this:

• Imagine a set of medical images that have been carefully reviewed by experienced doctors.

• A series of customer service conversations tagged with urgency levels.

This specialized data empowers AI to perform tasks with accuracy, speed and reliability.

To make it even simpler:

• General data is like collecting every cake recipe you can find online.
